examples.title: Ink Reveal | Community Components - 21st | 21st
examples.description: A canvas overlay that lets users brush away a colored mask to reveal content underneath. Mouse movement creates organic, wobbly ink stamps that expand and fade, producing a natural paint-stroke feel. Fully customizable — control brush size, mask color, lifetime, wobble, and more.
